body:
The kg-microbe #1123 name-disagreement review exposed an invalid Lysozyme CAS identifier. An arithmetic check of the current supported MIM candidate found three invalid CAS RNs:

| Subject | Published target | Calculated check digit | Stored digit |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| MIM:Izalpinin | cas:480-14-4 | 8 | 4 |
| MIM:Lysozyme | cas:2650-88-3 | 6 | 3 |
| MIM:Methyl-2-Hydroxy-Phenylproprionate | cas:89471-28-0 | 3 | 0 |

Checked against main `5019d6871fe0b0f47eccd50f9d0c169c98c40484` and the proposed #752 mapping-only follow-up. [CAS documents its check-digit method](https://www.cas.org/es-es/training/documentation/chemical-substances/checkdig): multiply the digits before the final check digit from right to left by 1, 2, ... and take the sum modulo 10. For Lysozyme, `8*1+8*2+0*3+5*4+6*5+2*6 = 86`, giving 6 rather than 3.

A valid checksum does not establish chemical identity. Do not repair these by substituting the calculated digit: a missing or substituted earlier digit is also possible. Lysozyme needs source/form review, not forced equivalence with FOODON:03413135 merely to clear a downstream disagreement.

Immediate containment: add exact row/owner-bound WITHHOLD decisions for these three CAS assertions while preserving the complete source payloads and unrelated local-identifier assertions. Historical/published release files stay immutable.

Remaining acceptance: inspect original source records, independently verify the intended compounds/materials and replacement identifiers, correct YAML/SSSOM via the existing mapping-change receipt chain, and explicitly re-review corrected rows. Add a supported-release CAS check-digit gate to prevent recurrence without confusing syntactic validity with identity approval. This issue remains open until source correction and the permanent gate are complete.

Related: #752 and https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/issues/1123.

comments.body:
Lysozyme containment is implemented in [MIM PR #754, ef9a2d93](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/commit/ef9a2d933faa682880fcdaddeb157b7753f747e3) and [KG-Microbe PR #1130, c4df95e3](https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/commit/c4df95e3d17fcd36a27c59b67cf2b96c9467df89).

- The original CultureBotHT row has only the generic name and invalid CAS `2650-88-3`, with no supplier/catalog or preparation evidence. Its complete source row and before-record are archived in [the source review](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/ef9a2d933faa682880fcdaddeb157b7753f747e3/reports/sssom_completion_20260921/mapping_review/identity-review-20260924/README.md).
- Keep `kgmicrobe.ingredient:lysozyme` as the unresolved source material. Remove the invalid RN from active identifiers/properties/SSSOM annotations and withdraw the unsupported FoodOn exact grounding. Historical source evidence retains the rejected value. No replacement CAS or preparation is inferred.
- The reviewed exporter now validates CAS syntax/check digits in `other` and `xref` as well as identity fields. Regression checks cover pipe-delimited annotations, whitespace, case and bare CAS values.
- KG-Microbe requires the local target for the generic name and blocks stale CAS/FoodOn equivalences from returning during lookup or consolidation. Actual candidate lookups for invalid `2650-88-3`, guessed `12650-88-3` and the local Lysozyme material were checked. A full scan finds no invalid Lysozyme RN in candidate identity, label or annotation fields; the local node has no CAS.

This resolves the remaining active-field contamination. **The original supplier/preparation evidence and any replacement identifier remain unresolved**, so keep this issue open. This batch does not claim to resolve the other two compounds covered here. Production promotion remains gated by KG-Microbe #1123.

Step 7(a) of the approved plan is being implemented from main `61ff4ed4789e61ef64f6f75a792adf3b934e7c82`. Fresh source inspection separates a demonstrable registry-value error from the unresolved primary-identity and preparation decisions.

For Izalpinin, correct the existing malformed `480-14-4` registry value to `480-14-8` in the current CAS identity, CAS mapping and active CAS property, through a guarded writer and the mapping-change receipt chain. This is supported by [PubChem CID 5318691](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/5318691) and the [manufacturer identity entry](https://www.medchemexpress.com/us/en/izalpinin.html); it is not a computed-check-digit substitution. Preserve the historical source payload and append the actual source/evidence history. Do not infer that the historical material was supplied by that manufacturer.

The broader ontology search also found a positive exact candidate: [LIPID MAPS LMPK12111656](https://www.lipidmaps.org/databases/lmsd/LMPK12111656). Its [primary API](https://www.lipidmaps.org/rest/compound/lm_id/LMPK12111656/all/json), OLS class and PubChem record agree on CID, formula, InChI and InChIKey. This is not a label-only lead. Current native source-enum, prefix and publication contracts do not support LIPIDMAPS. Therefore the bounded CAS-value repair will **retain WITHHOLD** and will not claim that CAS is the finalized best primary identity, that no exact ontology term exists, or that a new source has been approved.

The remaining source-policy decision is whether to implement LIPIDMAPS support through the complete native schema, validation and publication path, or adopt an explicit policy for retaining the verified CAS representation. Section 3 favors the exact term; I recommend evaluating its native integration separately rather than inserting an unsupported source or weakening a validator in this focused correction. The confirmed term and this unresolved decision will be included in the committed evidence.

Keep Methyl-2-Hydroxy-Phenylproprionate unchanged and WITHHOLD. Its original source lacks the supplier, locants and preparation evidence needed to select a replacement; neither the invalid number nor its calculated-digit variant resolved in the bounded PubChem requests. Do not guess a positional or stereochemical identity.

Keep Lysozyme's owner and SUPPORTED local-identity mapping byte-identical, including the existing source-scoped containment review. Its preparation and replacement-CAS question remains open; no guessed CAS, FoodOn grounding or supplier is added.

The existing reviewed exporter already checks CAS syntax/check digits in subject/object identities and `other`/`xref`; fresh native probes passed. Reuse and regression-test that contract instead of adding a second scanner. The new PR will include the actual corrected-row assessment, preserve unrelated canonical rows and deferred alias obligations, run the native receipt/review chain and full QC, and receive independent final-head review. This issue remains open for the unresolved decisions above.

title: Correct three supported CAS assertions with invalid check digits
